subtitle: Two-pane bookmark manager
iconPermissionError: Could not allow site icon downloads.
removeError: Could not delete the selected items.
moveError: Could not move the selected items.
iconPermission: Access to bookmarked websites is needed to download site icons.
reloadForIcons: Reload the extension to apply the site icon update.
selectAllHelp: Select all bookmarks and folders in the active pane.
selectNoneHelp: Clear all selections in the active pane.
createBookmarkHelp: Create a bookmark below the focused item in the active pane.
createFolderHelp: Create a folder below the focused item in the active pane.
deleteHelp: Delete the selected items in the active pane, or the focused item, after confirmation.
moveUpHelp: Move the selected items in the active pane up, keeping their order. If none are selected, move the focused item.
moveDownHelp: Move the selected items in the active pane down, keeping their order. If none are selected, move the focused item.
moveLeftHelp: Move the selected items from the right pane below the focused item in the left pane. If none are selected, move the focused item in the right pane.
moveRightHelp: Move the selected items from the left pane below the focused item in the right pane. If none are selected, move the focused item in the left pane.
resizeHint: Drag to resize panes; double-click for 50/50
createRetry: Could not create the item. Check the details and try again.
name: Name
navPanesHelp: Move focus to the left / right pane.
navTabHelp: Move focus to the other pane.
navOpenHelp: Open the bookmark in a new tab or open the folder.
selectToggleHelp: Toggle the focused item's selection without moving focus.
selectClickRangeHelp: Toggle each item's selection from the previously focused row to the clicked row, including both endpoints. Keep selections outside the range.
selectNextHelp: Toggle the focused item's selection and focus the next item.
selectPreviousHelp: Toggle the focused item's selection and focus the previous item.
selectFirstHelp: Toggle selection from the focused item through the first item, inclusive, and focus the first item.
selectLastHelp: Toggle selection from the focused item through the last item, inclusive, and focus the last item.
helpIntro: Keyboard shortcuts work when a pane has focus. Selecting an item again clears its selection.
escapeHelp: Close help or the language menu, or cancel creation or dragging.
confirmDelete:
Delete the selected items?
Number of items: {count}.
Folders and their contents will be deleted.
author: Author
